import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' to datetime for better handling
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by date and product
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a line plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', hue='product', marker='o')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Daily Total Sales by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' to datetime for better handling
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by date and product
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a line plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', hue='product', marker='o')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Daily Total Sales by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
